cap: Each inherited breast cancer gene has a normal job, and losing it explains the family pattern. BRCA1 and BRCA2 repair double-strand DNA breaks; BRCA1 carriers tend to get triple-negative cancers and BRCA2 carriers estrogen receptor-positive ones, including male breast cancer. TP53 loss gives Li-Fraumeni syndrome, PTEN Cowden syndrome, CDH1 lobular and diffuse gastric cancer, and STK11 Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.
